channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: After missing salary, employees at Indian-origin CEO's robotic soldier startup backed by Eric Trump lose health benefits
item.description: Foundation Future has terminated employees’ health benefits amid cash-flow concerns, after reports that it missed payroll in October. The robotics startup says it will offer COBRA coverage. CEO Sankaet Pathak has attributed the crisis to delayed funding from the South Korean investor Base Group.

item.title: Tata Sons lists EGM on board agenda amid vexed quorum issue
item.description: The meeting will also take up Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata’s repeated objections to proceedings of the board’s 17 September meeting, and discuss the conglomerate's loss-making businesses.

item.title: What Anthropic listing means for AI startups in India
item.description: The listing could draw more investors into India’s AI ecosystem, but startups face tougher questions over business models, revenue quality and dependence on global AI models.

item.title: Defence tech funding cools after Operation Sindoor gold rush
item.description: Defence tech funding has dropped to $73 million in 2026, marking a sharp slowdown from 2025, when investors poured $304 million into the sector across 61 deals.

item.title: Perfetti Van Melle to close 2026 at ₹4,000 crore revenue; tough year ahead, says MD
item.description: GST benefits and resilient margins buoyed the candy maker in 2026, but soaring sugar and packaging costs are testing the economics of low-priced packs and pushing it to nudge consumers towards larger sizes.

item.title: Bhavish Aggarwal's battery-cell bet runs into trouble as Ola Electric struggles with yields, sales
item.description: Ola Electric's plan was to make the cells in-house and turn a cost centre into a second growth engine. The factory at the heart of that plan is now struggling to meet its production targets.

item.title: Compass Plans to Move Main Listing to New York From London
item.description: The UK’s Compass Group Plc plans to move its primary listing from London to New York, according to a person familiar with the matter, marking yet another disappointment for the UK stock market.

item.title: Tata Steel’s ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo is part of a two-stage takeover transaction
item.description: Tata Steel has agreed to transfer its tubes business for up to ₹11,700 crore and its 100% stake in Tata Steel Colors for ₹16,300 crore to APL Apollo. Later, Tata Steel will buy APL Apollo’s promoter stake, and launch an open offer

item.title: Who is Prerna Jha? Former Zee5 executive returns to Jio Studios as AVP – Marketing; what did she say?
item.description: Jio Studios has appointed Prerna Jha as Associate Vice President of Marketing, bringing her back for a second stint. After nearly two years leading digital solutions at Jakarta-based Whisper World, Jha returns with experience in film marketing, streaming, media and consumer research.

item.title: JK Urbanscapes plans six hotels beyond metros to tap rising demand
item.description: India’s hospitality opportunity is becoming increasingly diverse, with growth extending beyond traditional hotel markets and formats. As business, leisure and experience-led travel evolve, developers and operators are taking a more market-led approach to identifying opportunities.

item.title: Who is Rajnish K Kaushik? Courtyard by Marriott Ranchi appoints hospitality veteran as executive chef
item.description: Courtyard by Marriott Ranchi has appointed Rajnish K. Kaushik as executive chef. With over 16 years of experience at hospitality brands including Marriott, Taj and Starwood, he will lead culinary operations, menu development, banquet services and food safety while mentoring the hotel’s kitchen team.

item.title: SpiceJet's troubles deepen: DGCA issues show cause notice over grounded planes, flight disruptions and unpaid penalties
item.description: The show cause notice, dated November 17, also flagged SpiceJet's failure to adhere to its approved flight schedule and persistent passenger inconvenience caused by disruptions, cancellations, delays and inadequate passenger facilitation measures.

item.title: M1xchange in talks with banks in Russia, Brazil for overseas expansion of India’s TReDS model
item.description: The TReDS platform is exploring technology-sharing partnerships with banks in the two countries as it seeks to expand beyond Africa, riding on India's growing invoice-financing ecosystem and a broader Brics push.

item.title: Going to be nuts! Elon Musk warns of massive AI cash crunch in 2027, asks ‘Where will that money come from?’
item.description: Elon Musk has warned of a massive cash crunch for the AI industry in 2027, as data centre expansion, rising chip costs and construction delays threaten to push up funding needs. Here's what he said.

item.title: Megaspeed was just one part of the story. Who is the man linked to Nvidia's China chip trail?
item.description: Who is Li Ming? The Chinese businessman allegedly linked to Alice Huang and a network accused of moving restricted Nvidia AI chips to China.

item.title: Microsoft overhauls Azure compensation model: Who gets extra stock and who faces scrutiny? Here's what changes
item.description: Microsoft is revising compensation in its Azure division to give top performers more stock awards and require formal discussions with employees falling short. The move reflects a broader push across the tech industry to improve productivity, amid Microsoft job cuts and voluntary buyouts.

item.title: Imperial Blue maker Pernod Ricard loses top spot as Johnnie Walker-owner Diageo reports ₹28,294 crore income in FY26
item.description: The company's total income, including other income, stood at ₹24,122.03 crore for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, marking a 12.8% decline from the previous fiscal year.

item.title: Tata Sons board meeting this week to revisit listing issue amid row
item.description: The board meeting is the first since September that exposed a rift between Noel Tata's Tata Trusts and Tata Sons over listing and reappointment of Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran.

item.title: Restaurants rethink expansion beyond casual dining
item.description: From premium dining destinations to delivery and cafe formats, restaurant companies are changing their expansion bets as delivery grows and large casual dining formats face pressure.

item.title: Nvidia shareholder writes open letter to board, calls for newly elected board leaders to decide on Jensen Huang's return
item.description: Nvidia shareholder Newman Nahas has urged the board to let three newly elected directors decide whether Jensen Huang should return, citing potential conflicts of interest among current directors amid controversy over the former CEO's departure.

item.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends 38 eateries during two-day crackdown; 17 in Pune | Here’s what they found
item.description: Maharashtra's FDA suspended licences of 38 establishments during a two-day statewide crackdown under its 'Safe Food, Safe Maharashtra' campaign. Pune Division accounted for 17 suspensions, with inspectors flagging unhygienic kitchens, insect infestations and food safety violations.

item.title: More trouble for Nvidia? California issues subpoena, probe to look at potential criminal law violations: What we know
item.description: California AG Rob Bonta is investigating whether Nvidia and its former CEO Jensen Huang violated state laws by misleading investors over alleged chip sales to China. The probe could lead to civil penalties or criminal proceedings against the chipmaker.

item.title: Amazon eyes $7.5 billion Decart deal to boost AI chip efficiency, challenge Nvidia | 5 things to know
item.description: Amazon is reportedly nearing a $7.5 billion acquisition of AI startup Decart, whose software helps AI models use chips more efficiently. The deal could strengthen AWS’s ability to compete with Nvidia&nbsp;

item.title: Who was Paolo Bulgari? Third-generation businessman who spearheaded the Italian jewellery business, passed away at 89
item.description: Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's jewellery business into one of the world's most prestigious luxury brands, has died aged 89. The former Bvlgari chairman oversaw its global expansion and diversification into watches, perfumes and hotels.

item.title: CrowdStrike’s Talks with Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
item.description: A wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers is reshaping the cybersecurity industry as the biggest companies race to expand their defenses against increasingly sophisticated attacks powered by artificial intelligence.

item.title: Bloom raises $75 million from Kedaara Capital to accelerate expansion, invest in AI technology
item.description: Tech-driven hospitality brand plans to expand portfolio to 12,000 rooms over the next few years

item.title: Who is Priya Timori? Orbit8 Media appoints marketing and technology professional as growth director
item.description: Priya Timori will lead business development, strategic partnerships and client relationships at Orbit8 Media. Her professional background spans enterprise sales, marketing and technology-led solutions.

item.title: IHCL marks 400-hotel milestone with Taj Yelahanka, deepens Krishna GVK partnership
item.description: IHCL has opened its 400th operating hotel with the launch of the 256-key Taj Yelahanka in Bengaluru. The property marks the seventh hotel under its 25-year partnership with Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels, which is targeting a portfolio of 2,200 keys and beyond.

item.title: What is Bagheera AT1? Adani Defence & Aerospace tests ATGM system in Rajasthan: Check capabilities, specifications
item.description: Adani Defence &amp; Aerospace demonstrated its vehicle-mounted Bagheera AT1 anti-tank missile system at Rajasthan’s Pokhran ranges. The system can engage targets up to 8 km away and was tested in day, night, tandem-firing and aerial-target scenarios.&nbsp;

item.title: Jensen Huang threatened Nvidia employees and made sexual remarks? New claims surfaced against ex CEO
item.description: A spokesperson from Jensen Huang has reacted to old claims against the ex Nvidia CEO. However, the company is yet to confirm or dismiss them.

item.title: Patanjali Foods faces fresh cow ghee safety action as Madhya Pradesh bans sale of one batch. Details inside
item.description: Patanjali Foods has said it will seek retesting and may appeal after Madhya Pradesh authorities banned the sale of a cow ghee batch declared unsafe. The development comes days after Maharashtra FDA seized 2,279 litres of the company's cow ghee from a distributor.
